verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev supports pre-production testing through a local dev server that executes tasks (docs-22). Community users praise Dev mode and say testing and local development are easy (comm-13, comm-9). The dashboard also offers a run inspector for debugging runs (docs-43). However, nothing in the evidence shows feeding sample or pinned payloads, or viewing input and output for each step. Missing for 10: sample/pinned test data, per-step input/output inspection, and detailed docs on the run inspector's contents.
